question.question: How may a Conservation Project enter play, what are support conditions/once limits, where does its token come from, when is the uncovered bonus taken, and what happens to overflowing projects/tokens?

fixed_key.expected_answer: Only play and immediately support; hand (or display with AssociationII paying folder within range). New leftmost above board shifts old right; max equal player count2/3/4; discard rightmost excess, tokens to owners supply not map. Base projects never shift/replenish. Support unoccupied fulfilled level once per project per player; choose token from left map, award shown tracks; uncovered bonus immediate before/after reward and recurring if marked.

a.answer: 1. Conservation Project work may support an existing project or bring a Conservation Project card from hand into play and support it immediately; with Association II a new project may also come from an in-range display card for its folder-number cost. 2. Fulfill a printed condition and choose a level with no player token on it; each level holds one token total, and normally you may support each project only once. 3. Take a player token from the left edge of your zoo map, put it on the chosen condition, and gain that level's conservation/reputation reward. Removing it activates its map bonus; take that bonus immediately, in either order with the project reward (and again at breaks if it is recurring income). 4. New projects enter above the Association board. If the row exceeds its player-count limit, discard the rightmost card; return tokens on it to owners' supplies, while activated map bonuses stay active. Setup Base Conservation Projects below the board never move or replenish.
a.evidence: Association conservation project work details entry, support limits and sequence, token source, bonus timing, overflow and project row distinction.

b.answer: 1) Association conservation work can support a project already in play or play a project from hand and support it immediately; Association II can instead take an in-range display project with folder-number extra cost. New projects go above the Association board, pushing existing cards right; overflow discards rightmost card and returns its tokens to owners’ supplies, leaving map bonuses activated. 2) Fulfill a printed condition, choose an available reward level with no player token, and normally support each project only once. Use a player token from the left edge of your map; receive project reward and uncovered map bonus, in either order. Recurring income bonus is received now and at each break. 3) Base projects below board stay in place. A new Release project also grants 1 reputation. Overflow details above.
b.evidence: Association conservation project work/support procedure and overflow.
